# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 49 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_049_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 49

**1** Jesus said: "Blessed are the solitary ones, the chosen — you will find the kingdom.

**2** Because you came from it, and you will go back to it."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "The chosen" — appositive to "solitary ones"; they are one group
- "Go back to it" — "return to it" rendered as going back; the journey is homeward

---
